detail_totals.schedule: GF Supporting Schedule of Cash Disbursements

notes: Modified cash basis school district. Governmental figures use the Total Governmental Funds column (p7), which is net of the Eliminations column (1,033,805). Business-type = School Nutrition Fund (p8; measure cash = net position 252,074). The statement's Transfers disbursement line (31,818 in total column) is the GF transfer to School Nutrition and is recorded as transfers_out, not a disbursement; reported governmental disbursements 98,725,266 include it. Receipts Transfers printed '-' in total column (1,000,000 to Depreciation and 33,805 to Activity eliminated). Combined lines split using the report's own fund schedules: Taxes (p7) split into property tax, carline (other taxes) and motor vehicle; Other local receipts, Non-revenue receipts and Debt service (p7) split likewise; USDA and State subsidy split into state 15,185 and federal 2,591,071 per p15. Governmental 'Debt service' interest includes Bond Fund other expenses 2,600. Transfer cross-check: Depreciation Fund transfer in 1,000,000 (p11) is hidden inside GF Instruction (333,334), Support services - instruction (333,333) and Operation and maintenance of plant (333,333) per the p7 elimination column; recorded as three contra expenditure lines plus one other financing -1,000,000 in GF detail (object lines unknown). GF transfers 65,623 (p23) = Activity Fund 33,805 (p7, eliminated) + School Nutrition 31,818 (p8, p15); matched. GF detail: expenditures from the supporting schedule of cash disbursements pp16-23 (more detailed; supersedes the function lines on the budget schedule pp9-10, which is used only for revenue). Object mapping: Purchased property services -> repairs and maintenance, Other purchased services -> professional/contract services, Property -> equipment purchases, Debt services and miscellaneous -> miscellaneous expenditure (review). Statement-level function mapping: Support services lines -> support services, Private and state categorical and Federal programs -> instruction (review). Activity Fund and Student Fee Fund have no detail schedule in the trimmed PDF (only totals on p6-7). Statement of Net Position (p1) Total column used for balance_sheet; no liabilities shown. Beginning cash 53,694,933 is the printed total beginning fund balances (p7). Reconciles: 53,694,933 + 85,551,672 - 98,693,448 - 31,818 = 40,521,339. Read pages 1-23 of 23. Central services (p7) split: Activity Fund 963,941 + Student Fee Fund 12,899 = 976,840 to student activities, remaining 4,417,430 support services. v7 re-trim: trimmed pp2-3 (report pp6-7, government-wide Statement of Activities - Modified Cash Basis) added; all later source_page numbers shifted +2. These pages repeat the statement totals (governmental disbursements 98,693,448, net position 53,694,933 -> 40,521,339; business-type School Nutrition 252,074) and add nothing new.
